personality_one_liner: Rugged, high-contrast operational field utility for construction attendance, overtime, biweekly payroll, and group foreman payments.

spacing.rule: Generous touch spacing with compact operational density for field workers and admins.

do's: Use sharp high-contrast cards and division lines for rugged outdoor legibility under direct sunlight.
dont's: Avoid heavy blur and translucent pastels that reduce outdoor readability.

screens.name: Auth / Role Selection
screens.purpose: Role login for Admin (PIN code) or Worker (Worker Code + PIN) with quick access toggle.

states.empty: Enter worker code / PIN or Admin passcode
states.error: Invalid PIN or worker code. Please retry.

screens.layout: Centered card with high-contrast amber/rust accent buttons and numeric PIN pad.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of active workers, daily attendance counts, project selector, and quick action shortcuts.

states.loading: Loading active projects and attendance counts...
states.empty: No active projects found. Create a project to start.
states.error: Failed to load dashboard metrics. Tap retry.

screens.layout: Scrollable metrics cards with project switcher banner and quick attendance/payroll tabs.

screens.name: Worker Attendance Timeline
screens.purpose: Log actual clock-in/out, morning 07:00-11:30, afternoon 13:00-17:00, no-rest 17:00-18:00, and hourly overtime.

states.empty: No workers registered for this project.
states.error: Could not sync attendance. Check connection.

screens.layout: Tap-based status controls (Full, Half Morning, Half Afternoon, Absent), time pickers, and overtime stepper.

screens.name: Worker & Group Management
screens.purpose: Manage workers across groups (Teknisi, Besi, Kayu, Finishing, Tukang, Kuli), rates, worker PINs, and foreman representation.

states.empty: No workers in this group. Add a worker below.

screens.layout: Segmented group filter tabs, list of workers with rates and PIN management modal.

screens.name: Biweekly Payroll & XLSX Export
screens.purpose: Calculate earnings for fixed periods (1-15 and 16-end), group-filtered payroll, foreman lump payments, and Excel export.

states.empty: No attendance records found for this period.

screens.layout: Period selector dropdown, summary totals card, group breakdown, foreman pay trigger, and Excel export button.

screens.name: Worker Self-Service Portal
screens.purpose: Read-only view for workers to check their own attendance history, hourly wages, overtime, and biweekly payout summary.
screens.layout: Clean personal badge header, summary stats, and chronological attendance log.

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain TukangGaji Pro dark utility aesthetic with warm rust/amber accents (#E05A36).
Support Admin login and Worker PIN login flow.
Include actual clock-in/out and calculated paid work hours with no-rest afternoon option (17:00-18:00) and hourly overtime from 18:00.
Implement worker groups: Teknisi, Besi, Kayu, Finishing, Tukang, Kuli.
Add group foreman representative payment flow and biweekly payroll periods (1-15 and 16-end) with XLSX export action.
Ensure all interactive targets are >=44x44pt and safe area is respected at screen roots.
